[[Image:River Eldar map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]
The '''River Eldar''' starts in the [[Mountains of Mist]] and flows in a southerly direction through [[Ghealdan]] and [[Altara]]. It forms the northern borders of [[Amadicia]], [[Ghealdan]] and [[Altara]] and empties into the [[Sea of Storms]]. It is joined by the [[River Boern]] at [[Boannda]].
